hints.text: A two-digit multiplier can be split into its tens and its ones. Multiply by each part separately and add the results.
Split $24$ into $20 + 4$. Work out $38 \times 20$ and $38 \times 4$, then add the two partial products.

explanation: Break $24$ into $20 + 4$ so the distributive property can be used.
Multiply by the tens part: $38 \times 20 = 760$, which is $38 \times 2$ with a zero attached.
Multiply by the ones part in the same way: $38 \times 4 = 152$.
Add the two partial products: $760 + 152 = 912$. So the answer is $38 \times 24 = 912$.
